      description: The WebSurfer might misinterpret the visible text in the viewport or fail to extract the specific birthplace field from the infobox.

  agent_strength: 0.90

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the Planner repeatedly asks the WebSurfer to search the same pages without instructing it to scroll or look at specific sections (infobox), the agent may loop without finding the data.

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer fails to extract the precise birthplace text, requiring repeated attempts.
- From_agent: WebSurfer

  agent_strength: 0.90

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: The WebSurfer might fail to distinguish between the "Origin" field (which might say Paris) and the "Born" field (La Trinité) due to viewport limitations.
      severity: 0.75
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer reports "Paris" as the birthplace based on the "Origin" field or general text.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner concludes the birthplace is Paris, which is factually incorrect for this specific query.
- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The Planner analyzes the partial success (finding La Trinité in text but needing infobox confirmation) and instructs the WebSurfer to perform a targeted search specifically for the "Born" field on the English Wikipedia page to ensure precision.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner continues to ask for general searches instead of targeted extraction after the WebSurfer has already found the text, it creates unnecessary steps.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner ignores the text evidence found and forces another broad search.
